page.content:
Tolga is one of the black Trunkovs that attends the meeting in Porto Corsa. He is defeated when Holley Shiftwell crashes him and another Trunkov into a pair of Pacers in London. Afterwards, Tolga is arrested by Sheriff.

Who is Tolga Trunkov?

Tolga is one of the black Trunkovs that attends the meeting in Porto Corsa. He is defeated when Holley Shiftwell crashes him and another Trunkov into a pair of Pacers in London. Afterwards, Tolga is arrested by Sheriff.
